resources.string: Pick a format; the settings change with the format you pick.
Report copied. You can send it to us by email or message.
If you can\'t sign in or the server can\'t be reached, copy or share the report and send it to us.
Which server the app connects to: the remote server or one running on a computer on your local network.

Your phone and computer must be on the same Wi-Fi. Run Yerel-Sunucuyu-Baslat.bat on the computer, then enter the address it shows or tap Search network. The connection is unencrypted; use it only on your own network.
Only a local network address is allowed (e.g. 192.168.1.20:4747).
